autoRefreshSeconds.title: Auto-refresh interval
autoRefreshSeconds.description: Refresh the visible Mise tool window at this interval. Set to 0 to disable.

redactEnvironment.title: Redact sensitive environment values
redactEnvironment.description: Mask values whose names look like passwords, tokens, keys, cookies or credentials.

followEditorContext.title: Follow the active editor directory
followEditorContext.description: Resolve Mise's parent, local, environment, and nested configuration hierarchy from the active editor's directory. Disable to always use the project root.

registerRunTarget.title: Offer Mise as a run target
registerRunTarget.description: Make the mise exec wrapper available in the Run Target selector. Enabling it may add Mise to run-configuration labels when selected as the project target.
